data.standardized_narrative: The report's balance sheet shows gross claims outstanding at the 2015 comparative (opening for 2016) at approximately GBP 231.733m. The published notes and narrative in the scanned images provided do not contain a clearly labelled gross movement figure for prior years (gross prior year development) that can be unambiguously extracted. As a result the prior year development amount (gross) could not be determined from the available images. Gross written premiums for 2016 are stated as GBP 378.235m.
data.data_quality_notes: Document supplied as scanned images with rotated pages. Key reserve movement notes (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) could not be unambiguously located or parsed in the provided images. The opening gross claims outstanding was read from the Balance Sheet liabilities 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative column but the figure is partially obscured and read with moderate confidence. No clear gross prior-year movement (gross PYD) line was found in the scanned pages; narrative references to 'net' movements appear in places but a gross figure could not be identified. The claims development triangle and technical provisions reconciliation are present in the report (pages ~40-41 and ~39) but were not reliably parsed from the supplied images; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null rather than using a possibly net figure or misread table. If a higher-certainty extraction is required please provide higher-resolution images or the native PDF text.
